- **Confirmation**: Both Agent A and Agent B agree on this unified definition.

- **Final Approval**: Both agents have approved the delivery note before submission.

- The unified completion criteria were established and agreed upon.
- Both agents completed their tasks and reported results.
- The supervisor review confirmed that all criteria were met.
- Final approval was obtained from both agents, ensuring the process was thorough and coordinated.

This structured approach ensures that the bugfix delivery note is accurate and meets the defined standards for completion.
